#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int readInt() {
    int ans = 0;
    bool neg = false;
    int c;
    bool start = false;
    while ((c = getchar()) != EOF) {
        if (c == '-') {
            start = true;
            neg = true;
            continue;
        } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
            start = true;
            ans = ans * 10 + c - '0';
        } else if (start) {
            break;
        }
    }
    return neg ? -ans : ans;
}

int r, c;
long long C[64][64];
long long best = LLONG_MAX;

long long dfs(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2, vector<vector<long long>>& C, int r) {
    long long d = llabs(x - y);
    if (best <= 1 || d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] >= best) return LLONG_MAX;
    if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
        if (d < best) best = d;
        return d;
    }
    long long res = LLONG_MAX;
    if (v1 > 0) {
        long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
        res = std::min(res, dfs(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2, C, r));
    }
    if (v2 > 0) {
        long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        res = std::min(res, dfs(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1, C, r));
    }
    return res;
}

long long solve(long long x, long long y, int v1, int v2, vector<vector<long long>>& C, int r, const std::string& cs, std::map<long long, long long>& cache) {
    long long k = x * 10000 + v1 * 100 + v2;
    auto it = cache.find(k);
    if (it != cache.end()) return it->second;
    long long v = 0;
    long long d = llabs(x - y);
    if (d - C[v1][r] * C[v2][r] > best) {
        cache[k] = v;
        return v;
    }
    if (v1 == 0 && v2 == 0) {
        cache[k] = 1;
        return 1;
    }
    char c = cs[v1 + v2 - 1];
    if (v1 > 0 && c != 'B') {
        long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
        v += solve(x, y + c1 * s2, v1 - 1, v2, C, r, cs, cache);
    }
    if (v2 > 0 && c != 'A') {
        long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
        v += solve(x + s1 * c2, y, v1, v2 - 1, C, r, cs, cache);
    }
    cache[k] = v;
    return v;
}

int main() {
    r = readInt();
    c = readInt();
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s); // consume remaining newline
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    std::vector<char> cs(s.begin(), s.end());

    int size = 2 * (r + c);
    for (int i = 0; i <= size; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= size; j++) {
            if (j == 0) C[i][j] = 1;
            else if (i == 0) C[i][j] = 0;
            else C[i][j] = C[i - 1][j - 1] + C[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    int v1 = r + c;
    int v2 = r + c;
    long long x = 0, y = 0;
    while (v1 > 0 && v2 > 0) {
        if (x > y) {
            long long c1 = C[v1][r] - C[v1 - 1][r], s2 = C[v2][r];
            y += c1 * s2;
            v1--;
        } else {
            long long s1 = C[v1][r], c2 = C[v2][r] - C[v2 - 1][r];
            x += s1 * c2;
            v2--;
        }
    }
    best = llabs(x - y);
    std::map<long long, long long> cache;
    dfs(0, 0, v1, v2, C, r);
    v1 = r + c;
    v2 = r + c;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        // countA and countB are not needed explicitly for final output
    }
    long long ans = solve(0, 0, v1, v2, C, r, std::string(cs.begin(), cs.end()), cache);
    std::cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
